mapper.select: SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN r.id AS sourceId,r.projectId AS originalProjectId,canonical.projectId AS canonicalProjectId,p.projectCode AS originalProjectCode,p.projectType,r.partyRole,r.partyCode,r.partyName,r.createTime,r.createBy AS source_creator,r.updateTime,r.updateBy AS source_updater,r.effectiveFrom,r.effectiveTo FROM pm_project_related_party r JOIN pm_project p ON p.projectId=r.projectId JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) canonical ON canonical.typeKey=CAST(p.projectType AS BINARY) AND canonical.codeKey=CAST(p.projectCode AS BINARY) JOIN pm_project current_project ON current_project.projectId=canonical.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.disabled=0 AND current_project.effectiveTo IS NULL AND current_project.projectType='10' ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit}
